main_text.p: Iominus ut singulari nostra patientia adversariorum malitiam tandem expugnaremus, deputatos nostros denuo ad aulam delegavimus, æquissimis mandatis instructos, utpote quibus nihil aliud contineretur & peteretur, quam quod antea concessum fuit, & regis sereniss. sigillo & chirographo obsignatum, quodque a tam pio & justo rege rejici non potuit: Etenim summa & subjectum omnium nostrarum supplicationum, protestationum, informationum, declarationum a principio fuit, ut fundamentales regni leges (haactenus violatæ) & religio (aperte haactenus corrupta) in libera synodo nationali & parlamento denuo sancirentur, & in violationis utriusque improbos authores animadverterentur; quæ magis expresse in articulis pacis exprimuntur, quibus cautum fuit, ut res omnes politicæ parlamenti, & Ecclesiasticæ synodi judicio definirentur: porro cum synodus a rege promissa & concessa, controversias omnes ecclesiasticas feliciter composuisset, dignaretur rex sereniss. parlamentum concludere, quo decreta illa ecclesiastica sancirentur, & controversiæ aliæ civiles legitime componerentur, prout diserte pactum fuit in tractatu pacificatorio ad castra regia. Propositiones tamen hæ quantumvis pernecessariæ, a sereniss. & clementissimi regis nostri auribus exclußæ fuerunt, per Archiepiscopum Cantuariensem & Deputatum Hiberniæ, qui (factione papistica circa regem præpotenti valide muniti) omnia negotia tam politica quam ecclesiastica soli expediunt, & ut operæ suæ necessitatem serenis. regi ostendant, prætextu vindicandi honoris regii, justa subditorum privilegia & veram reformatam religionem in omnibus regis regnis opprimunt.
In quo impio conatu jure meritoque dicimus ipsos plurimum profecisse, si præsens concessio libe-ræ synodi

page.notes: Catchword absent. The first line begins with a fragment "Iominus" (the page opens mid-sentence, the initial D is missing/unprinted in the scan, so it is shown as printed). Long s rendered as s throughout. Some letters are damaged by the scan: "summa" and "subjectum" read with confidence; "haactenus" is printed "hactenus" (rendered as printed in the scan, ligature-like "ha" and "ct"); "sereniss." abbreviation kept. Words "sancirentur" and "sancirentur" appear as printed. The last word "libe-" continues on the next page as "ræ synodi" which is set at the right of the final line. Lines near the bottom and right edge are faint; words possibly misread: "exclußæ" (printed as exclusæ, letters partly obscured) [?], "ostendant" [?].
